prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1192; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver reporting a low-speed head-on collision in a parking area. Vehicles are drivable. Claimant vehicle reported as stopped at the time of impact. Photos requested from both parties and a recorded statement scheduled with the insured.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from the insured. Insured states the other vehicle crossed into their lane while turning. Damage described as front bumper and grille on insured vehicle, front end on claimant vehicle. No airbag deployment reported by either party. Police report not filed; both parties exchanged information at scene.

Entry 3: Notice received that the claimant is represented by counsel. All further contact to be directed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation placed in file. Claimant reports a knee injury following the collision and has been seen at an urgent care facility. Medical records and itemized bills requested through counsel.

Entry 4: Field appraisal completed on both vehicles. Estimated repair documentation received from two shops and under review. Liability analysis preliminary, with fault leaning toward the other driver based on the statement and photographs. Reserve set pending receipt of medical documentation.

Entry 5: Counsel's office acknowledged the medical records request and indicated the claimant is still treating for the knee injury. Follow-up requested on physical therapy status and any imaging results. File flagged for supervisor review due to represented injury claim. Next review scheduled once records are received.
